subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should Telegram/ACP source turns enforce an action-verification or fail-closed policy when visible final text claims completed side effects without matching tool evidence?
rationale: Current main intentionally permits automatic final replies in some source chats and only warns for the narrower `message_tool_only` private-final case; changing that behavior affects privacy, compatibility, and existing channel workflows.

options.title: Define a verification policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which action claims require tool-ledger evidence and what diagnostic or retry behavior should occur when evidence is missing.

options.title: Scope to stranded-final recovery only
options.body: Land or reject the narrower recovery PR for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85714 and leave broader action-claim verification out of core for now.

options.title: Document current behavior
options.body: Treat model-side false completion as an operator/model limitation, document the recommended `message_tool` and hook-based mitigations, and close this direction once maintainers explicitly accept that boundary.

recommendation.title: Define a verification policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which action claims require tool-ledger evidence and what diagnostic or retry behavior should occur when evidence is missing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source-reply policy history and the merged diagnostics mitigation make this the strongest available routing candidate for the policy call.
